pages.text: The roots have not vanished. The rhythm beneath them has.
pages.title: After silence
A quieter country
pages.text: Defeating a dimension's campaign threat records that dimension as cleared. Its Bloom seeding is silenced until the campaign is reset. Other dimensions retain their own threats and their own histories.

pages.title: A quieter country
pages.text: Neutralizing a threat is not an explanation for its origin. Leave that page open.
